info.description:
Auto-generated from the LCS FastAPI OpenAPI schema (`GET /openapi.json`).

## How to use
1. Set collection variable `base_url` (default `http://localhost:8000`; production is `https://lcslog.minidev.in`).
2. Set `username` / `password` variables, then run **01 Authentication > POST /api/v1/auth/login**.
   The test script stores `data.access_token` into the `access_token` variable automatically.
3. Every other request sends `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` via the collection-level auth.
4. POST/GET list requests auto-capture the first row id into collection variables (`user_id`, `quotation_id`, ...), so `:id` routes are runnable after their list call.

## Response envelope
- Success: `{ "data": ... }`
- Lists: `{ "data": { "items": [...], "meta": { page, page_size, total } } }`
- Error: `{ "code", "message", "request_id", "field_errors" }`

## Notes
- Request bodies are schema-derived examples - adjust values before sending; some fields have domain constraints (currency, status enums, period locking).
- Optional filter query parameters are present but **disabled** by default.
- `DELETE` routes are real and destructive. Point `base_url` at a disposable database when exercising them.

## Known contract deviation
`GET /health`, `GET /health/ready` and `GET /` are unversioned infra probes that return a bare object, not the `{"data": ...}` envelope (`GET /api/v1/health` does use the envelope). Their tests assert the real probe shape; every `/api/v1/**` response is asserted against the documented envelope.
